Buddy Pokémon

Your Buddy: daily hearts, friendship tiers and what it finds.

HeartsFriendship tiersFriendship evolutionsFinds

Pick one Pokémon from the PC as your Buddy. It walks behind your trainer on the route and in the strip, shows on your trainer card (friends see it), and picks things up while you hunt. Holding its Mega Stone, it's shown in that form.

Hearts

Each Pokémon can earn up to 6 hearts a day, one per task. You can swap Buddy 3 times a day (going back to one you had today is free). A new day starts at midnight UTC.

TaskHow
Hunt togetherMeet 40 wild Pokémon with it as your Buddy
Win battlesWin 10 route battles with it in your party
Catch PokémonCatch 5 Pokémon while it is your Buddy
PlayClick your Buddy on the route or on its card
Raid or TowerBring it into a Raid battle or a Tower climb
Share a treatGive it one of its own family Candy

Friendship tiers

TierHeartsFinds about everyPerk
Buddy034 wild PokémonFinds something about every 34 wild Pokémon
Good Buddy630 wild PokémonFinds a little more often (about every 30)
Great Buddy4227 wild PokémonFinds more often (about every 27), +1 Candy per Candy find
Ultra Buddy12624 wild PokémonFinds about every 24, Rare Candy twice as likely
Best Buddy30020 wild PokémonFinds about every 20, the best Rare Candy odds, +2 Candy, and the Best Buddy ribbon and sparkle

Friendship evolutions

A Good Buddy (6 hearts) can take its friendship evolutions (Golbat → Crobat, Chansey → Blissey, Eevee → Espeon / Umbreon / Sylveon…) at any level. Day or night, gender and Sylveon's Fairy move still decide the branch. Any other Pokémon still gets them at Lv 20 as before. When your Buddy reaches Good Buddy, the Buddy panel shows an Evolve button (branching lines: pick in the PC).

Finds

After each wild encounter (except a loss) your Buddy may find something, about once every N encounters (N by tier, above). What it finds:

FindBuddyBest Buddy
Its family Candy61.1%57.4%
2 Great Balls10.5%9.9%
Super Potion7.4%6.9%
Nugget10.5%9.9%
An evolution stone5.3%5%
Rare Candy4.2%9.9%
Big Nugget1.1%1%

Candy finds give 1–2 of its family Candy, +1 at Great and Ultra Buddy, +2 at Best Buddy.
